title: Comrades-In-Arms
paragraphs: The brat went as far as to mock even Sakura-chan, and it seems the fiancé had finally reached their limit.
“Hmph! Fine. If you can land even a single hit on me, I’ll admit defeat and apologize for everything up until now. But against the likes of you two, I can handle this on my own. Come at me!”
“…Alright.”
The fiancé nodded and let go of Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan then stood up with the fiancé on her back.
“Wide open! Are you an idiot?”
Taking advantage of what seemed like an opening, the brat lunged forward with her small sword.
“Hup! Hah! Toh!”
Sakura-chan dodged every single attack effortlessly. And she was supposed to be “wide open”? What nonsense.
“Tch! Why isn’t it hitting!? You don’t even look that fast!”
“I can move even faster, y’know? But I just dodged normally.”
“Grr! Hmph! I’m not done yet! Stop dodging! If you dodge again, I’ll make you pay for it!”
That being said, there was no reason to just stand there and take a hit. Sakura-chan continued to evade before tripping the brat with her foot.
“Ouch! You injured me! I won’t forgive you for this!”
The brat shot a furious glare at Sakura-chan, who returned the glare in kind.
“Didn’t you say that even a little injury would mean your loss?”
“That doesn’t count! I just tripped, that’s all!”
The fiancé replied calmly, but the brat was livid.
“Grr! Just bleed already and collapse! Stop dodging!”
While carrying the fiancé, Sakura-chan dodged both the brat’s small sword and her obviously telegraphed magic attacks.
“There, right, left, feint.”

It seemed the fiancé had completely read the brat’s movements, offering precise advice that allowed Sakura-chan to evade everything. While instinct alone could be enough to dodge, sometimes, the brat’s movements were unpredictable, possibly due to dabbling in some odd fighting style.
“Alright, here I go!”
Just as Sakura-chan was about to retaliate, lightly pressing her foot into the ground to launch an attack—
“Haahhhhhh!”
“Taaahhhhh!”
She was suddenly blown away from the side.
“Kyann—! Ugh…!”
“Kyaaah!?”
Sakura-chan and the fiancé were both knocked to the ground, unable to even brace themselves for impact.
“Ugh…”
As the fiancé hurriedly got up, she saw that Sakura-chan was bleeding profusely from a wound on her head.
Tch… Just hearing about it makes my chest tighten…
“Sakura-chan!”
“Wh-What just happened…?”

While the fiancé rushed to provide first aid, Sakura-chan, refusing to lose her fighting spirit, wobbled as she tried to stand. Right in front of them, shielding the brat, stood two of her companions—one with a massive dragon arm and the other with wings.
“Nana-sama… are you alright?”
“Honestly… what are you even doing in a place like this?”
“Reirdia! Ashell!”
The brat, now certain of her victory, smiled smugly at the two.
“To think you were wasting time here fighting… a Filolial mutation.”
“Seriously… what were you even doing with a thing like that?”
Sakura-chan glared at them, exuding killing intent. Just by looking, she could tell. Even though they were in human form, they were a dragon and a griffin.
“I don’t know what you’re talking about! That Filolial suddenly attacked me!”
“That’s a lie!”
The fiancé shouted in anger while pressing down on Sakura-chan’s wound to stop the bleeding.
“It was you who drew your weapon and attacked first! You started this fight without our consent!”
Hearing the fiancé’s response, the two creatures glanced at the brat. But without even investigating, they immediately responded:
“As if Nana, Takt’s sister, would ever lie. As expected, the princess from that nation, who has been deceived by a Filolial, appears to be quite the compulsive liar.”
“Exactly. Anyone who favors those flightless birds is a liar by nature.”The brat, fully convinced of her victory, taunted from behind the two creatures.
How utterly infuriating! If I had been there, I would have killed her on the spot!
“In any case, the crime of attempting to lay a hand on Lady Nana is punishable by death! We will finish you here!”
“Die, Filolial!”
The two creatures each began chanting powerful magic and unleashed their spells. One conjured an enormous ice chunk, while the other compressed a tornado into a single devastating blast.
“Mel-chan, watch out!”
“Kyah! Sakura-chan!?”
Sakura-chan shoved the fiancé away to protect her. At that moment, the incoming ice chunk and tornado appeared to slow down in her vision.
“Nano!”
Just as Sakura-chan sensed the danger— A fireball suddenly shot down from the sky and exploded, shielding her from the attack. The impact deflected the now-slowed ice chunk and tornado.
“What do you think you’re doing, nano!?”
With a swift landing, the rival stood protectively in front of Sakura-chan, carrying her assistant.
“Hm? The Dragon Emperor…? To think you would defend a Filolial… What a disgraceful dragon you are. You are unworthy of your title and deserve death!”
“Ganging up on an injured opponent three-on-one—how cowardly, nano!”
“Cowardly? You dare call me, the most powerful and noble Dragon Emperor, a coward!? And you, a lowly, filthy dragon, have the audacity to defend a Filolial!?”
“Dragon or Filolial, it doesn’t matter, nano! Cowardice is cowardice!”
“Hmph! There’s no such thing as cowardice when dealing with the likes of you Filolial maggots! If you enter my sight, you will be mercilessly slaughtered!”

Sakura-chan and the rival locked eyes. Though they were both rivals competing over Father, they seemed to share a mutual understanding at this moment. Perhaps they were even comrades-in-arms in some sense.
“So that’s… a Dragon Emperor different from Father… So selfish… Nothing like Father at all…”
Even the assistant, after observing the opponent, seemed to be fired up for battle. She claimed that their actions defiled the pride and dignity of dragons.
Hah! I wouldn’t know anything about that. But since they protected Sakura-chan, I’ll offer my gratitude—just this once.
And… I have no choice but to acknowledge this one as a worthy rival.
“To appear before me so foolishly—how convenient. I shall take that fragment from you!”
“I won’t lose to a dragon without the pride of a true dragon, nano!”
What began as a childish scuffle was escalating into a serious battle. The rival also possessed a portion of the Dragon Emperor fragments that we had gathered.
However… the rival had yet to undergo a class upgrade and had only improved her inherent abilities. I doubt she can win.
“This time, I will protect Sakura-chan!”

The fiancé stepped forward to shield Sakura-chan and, despite the sudden appearance of an unknown ally, chose to support the rival. However, due to the significant level difference, both the fiancé and the rival were quickly cornered. That said, they put up an impressive fight despite facing enemies with more than double their level.
“Take this!”
The brat launched a spell, as if signaling the start of an attack. Seizing the moment, the Griffin and the Dragon Emperor attacked in unison—
“—Air Strike Shield!”

The magic had already been fired toward Sakura-chan and the others. There was no sign of it stopping, and it was unclear whether the assistant would be able to interfere in time— But then, a shadow stepped in between them. A summoned shield nullified the brat’s magic, draining its power. In the same instant, the attacks from the Griffin and the Dragon Emperor that had been aimed at the fiancé and Sakura-chan were deflected effortlessly. Then, a voice spoke.
“…I’m not sure what’s going on here, but from where I’m standing, it just looks like a one-sided assault—so I decided to stop it.”
Standing there, cradling a mole, was none other than Father. As expected of Father.
He appeared at the moment of crisis! Though, I must say, Fiancée sure talks about him a lot. Well, it’s only natural—Father is incredibly cool, after all.
